newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh gas field on fire.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh gas field on fire.

text.p: Fire engulfed a gas field in northeastern Bangladesh on Sunday where U.S. company Occidental began drilling early this month, fire brigade officials and witnesses said.
Fire broke out at the drilling site following an explosion in a well, they said.
Occidental, which has won the right for exploration of hydrocarbon in the Sylhet region, began drilling on June 2.
An official of state-run oil and gas agency Petrobangla said the accident occurred because of sudden "upward pressure (of gas)". He did not elaborate.
Officials in Moulavi Bazar, some 200 km (125miles) northeast of Sylhet, said they saw fire above the forest at Magurchhara gas field at around 2 a.m.
Local journalists said dozens of workers at the gas field were injured but officials would not comment.
Equipment and vehicles were destroyed, they said. Railway tracks passing by the gas field also caught fire, disrupting train services.
